name: maxxfactory
description: A lights-out software factory for AI coding agents. Flagship models plan a Linear project adversarially (pre-mortem by another vendor), cheaper models build it ticket by ticket, another model inspects every round until it converges. Runs unattended for hours on the subscriptions you already pay for: every quota used before its reset, credits never bought, no token spent twice. Works with Claude Code, Codex, opencode, pi, Grok, Antigravity, Mistral Vibe.
